title: ABAP Workbench
description: Mockup of an ABAP system seen through ARC-1 (ADT): object search, source code with KTD, where-used analysis and transport check. Sample data; the real server is read-only by default.
insights: Select an object once: source, KTD, where-used and the transport check all follow it.
The transport check flags an object that sits in several modifiable requests with different owners.
Ask Joule shows the tool calls (SAPSearch, SAPRead, SAPContext, SAPNavigate, SAPTransport) behind each answer. With the ARC-1 connector installed, the same questions run on your system.
Fictional sample data. No SAP system is called and nothing is changed.
prompt: Bundled example: ABAP Workbench via ARC-1 (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
